$comment: The one statement of who this site is. scripts/post_build_aeo_geo.js builds the published Dentist/LocalBusiness node from this file (name, logo, description, sameAs) and the page author node from its author block and writes it into the head of every page; scripts/validate_entity_graph.js refuses the build if this file and the served pages ever disagree; scripts/entity_backlink_watch.js (.github/workflows/entity-backlink-watch.yml, weekly) refetches every profile and self-heals. sameAs lists ONLY third-party pages that are this same real-world practitioner and resolve now. Never a URL on this site's own host, and never a profile nobody has verified.
name: Dr. Cynthia Brown, DDS
description: Dr. Cynthia Brown, DDS — dentist seeing patients in Olive Branch and Southaven, Mississippi.

author.name: Dr. Cynthia Brown, DDS
author.jobTitle: Dentist, Olive Branch and Southaven, Mississippi

author_why: Search Readiness c6 (3 Nov 2026): every content page used to carry no named author or reviewer, so a reader and an answer engine met pages nobody had put their name to. This is the one statement of who reviews the words on this site. scripts/build_site.js renders the visible byline from it and scripts/post_build_aeo_geo.js publishes it as the author of every page's WebPage node; scripts/validate_page_byline.js refuses a build where a page, the byline and this file disagree. She is a real, named dentist reviewing her own site's copy through /admin/ — never an invented byline or credential. Only a name and credential, never a date: a review date would be a freshness claim nothing here can prove.
parentOrganization_note: Deliberately none. This is a client's own professional practice, not part of any portfolio, so no parent organisation is published (Search Readiness k4 for a client site: naming one would be an invented relationship).

https://www.aspendental.com/providers/cy.what: The practitioner's own provider profile on the practice group that publishes her schedule — the same real-world dentist, and already this site's only approved booking destination (data/system/booking_links.json defaultBookingUrl).
https://www.aspendental.com/providers/cy.probed: 2026-11-03: HTTP 200 after redirects, read with a desktop browser user agent.
https://www.aspendental.com/providers/cy.linkback_why: A third-party provider directory page the practice does not edit. It is listed because it is the same entity and it resolves; a missing link back from it is not a defect anyone here can fix, so the weekly watch records its state and raises nothing.

profiles_pending_why: Empty on purpose. A profile is added here only once it exists and someone has read it; the site never publishes a guessed or aspirational profile URL.
